title: Reposting:75 stays75, changes yield90 and unposting preserves the other recorder
goal: Verify repeat/replacement/unposting without duplication or losing another recorder.
prerequisites: onec.p5; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
outcomes: Each transition has an independent expectation.
Other recorder retained until its own unposting.
sections: Posting transforms the current document into a movement set. Identical input should yield an equivalent set regardless of repetition. Compare dimensions, resources, periods and recorder—not merely one total. Opposite duplicates can cancel numerically while leaving invalid records.

Begin with own30/45 requests totaling75. Reposting the first is not another30-minute fact: movements represent current document state rather than button presses. The handler clears and rebuilds its own object’s set.
A change replaces the prior effect

Changing 30→45 replaces the recorder’s old effect under the agreed policy. Appending 45 gives 75 incorrectly. For multiline documents, test a removed line: its old movement must disappear. Define behavior for an empty document too.
Changing the first30→45 replaces its effect, giving90 rather than120. Unposting it leaves the second45; unposting the second leaves0 for this own customer, without clearing other customers.

Failure between removing old and writing new records must not leave a partial effect. Inject failure only in a new copy and test atomicity. Reread document/register in a fresh session. Transactions and locks address different concerns: one change’s consistency versus interacting concurrent changes.
A parameterized query checks each stage. A correct final0 could hide an earlier duplication, so retain all five claims:75,75,90,45,0. Unposting retains document identity.
Use a matrix beyond the happy path

Use post 30, repeat 30, change 45, remove a line, reverse, repost. Record counts and movement identities at every step. Include another recorder to expose accidental deletion of someone else’s set. Preserve both the current invariant and independent earlier documents.

A31/45 negative set gives76 despite the same count. The initial75 expectation must detect it. Specify a separate injected posting failure to check atomic old/new state; concurrent posting needs suitable separate sessions and is not established by one file-base experiment.
